summary: Merge house and merge decor in this puzzle game. Family story games for you!
description:
Welcome to the Travel Merge Family! It is a New Adventure Casual Game, the go-to merge game that takes you on a journey like no other! Dive into an immersive blend of merge puzzle mechanics. You need to merge city, merge island, merge mansion, merge garden, and also merge food. Do you like to play with the merge puzzle casual game and home decorating? Then this game is for you!

One married couple buys a suspiciously underpriced house. They move in and realize that there’s nothing but locked empty rooms and weird notes left by the previous owner…

MATCH & MERGE
- Merge matching items, and create new ones as you progress through the game.

RESTORE & DECORATE
- Solve the house mystery, decorate its rooms, and enjoy the family atmosphere;
- Open various rooms: their own gym and home theatre, their barbecue zone and swimming pool, etc. Moreover, they will find the secret room or rooms?!

ADVENTURE & TRAVEL
- Discover the world around you, visit different countries, and look for exotic animals and plants.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
- Make friends, help them water their plants, and feed their animals.

All in all, find your satisfaction in the family atmosphere and the perfection home space creation. Decorate, explore, and socialize! Make your life truly vibrant!
